notes: Text-effect presets now work on text layers too. Each text layer's header gets the same ✨ Effects button (next to Copy / Paste / ✕) that opens the presets gallery and applies a preset to that layer. The gallery is shared between the main caption and layers; for a layer the 'Apply to all scenes' option is hidden (a preset targets that one layer). Layer presets map the bundle onto the layer's field names (textStyle / animation + the shared colour overrides) and save via the extraTexts array. index.html only; a browser hard-refresh picks it up.
